method: live births to mothers aged 15–48 / arithmetic mean of population of women in matching exact age at end of year t-1 and t * 1000
caveats: Approximate exposure, not midyear population or exact person-years.
Counts liveborn children, not pregnancies or unique birthing women.
Excludes births to mothers under 15 and 49+.
Does not measure the probability of conception.
